# `em select mirrors list`

- **Usage:** `em select mirrors list [-c --country <COUNTRY>] [-r --region <REGION>]`

List available Gentoo distfile mirrors (marks those already selected)

## Flags
- **`-c --country <COUNTRY>`** — Keep only mirrors in this ISO country code (e.g. `US`, `DE`)
- **`-r --region <REGION>`** — Keep only mirrors in this region (e.g. `Europe`, `North America`)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
